messages:
emma_sdr: Quick Q from FinBank POC — they require EU-only data path + BYO-KMS.
Can we confirm the sub-processor list for EU regions and whether any control plane / telemetry ever crosses into non-EU? cc @aj_prod_engineer @liam_netops

aj_prod_engineer: Short answer: inference data stays in-region for hosted endpoints in eu-* regions, but we need to check two things: control plane signaling and observability sinks. For Hosted API some metrics/logs are shipped to our monitoring backplane which lives in us-west by default.

liam_netops: Correct. Network flow: request -> regional ingress -> inference pool in same region. KV/cache + model shards are pinned to region when tenant tag = `geo:eu`.
Fallback: if regional capacity is exhausted, default behavior is to fallthrough to compatible region (eu-west-1 -> eu-central-1). That fallback is configurable in the tenant route policy.

aj_prod_engineer: We can set `failover: deny-cross-border` for the POC so no cross-border failover. Example routing snippet they can sign off on:

```
{"tenant": "finbank-poc", "routing": {"primary": ["eu-west-1"], "failover": [], "pin_byo_kms": true}}
```

sara_security: Also important: BYO-KMS changes key escrow and audit flow. We need the customer's KMS public fingerprint + attestation that KMS key is in EU region. For sub-processors, provide this doc: https://redwood.example.com/subproc-eu-2025.pdf — it lists infra, logging vendor, monitoring vendor and whether they store data.

emma_sdr: Do we have an updated SLA/pricing delta for geo-pin + BYO-KMS? Customer asked about cost impact.

aj_prod_engineer: Pricing note: EU-only pinning + BYO-KMS -> 8-12% uplift on hosted due to capacity reservation and extra crypto ops. Dedicated gets negotiated. I'll add exact numbers to the quote but flagging now.

liam_netops: Ops caveat: enclave + BYO-KMS adds ~30s cold-start on some GPU pools due to key rotation handshake. If they need <100ms tail latency we should propose Dedicated with prewarmed nodes.

sara_security: From a compliance angle: provide them SOC2 + data flow map + per-region subproc attestations. I can sign the questionnaire if they share it.

emma_sdr: Perfect. Action items:
- @aj_prod_engineer: add geo-pin routing JSON + pricing uplift to quote (ETA EOD)
- @liam_netops: confirm fallback is disabled and note cold-start impact
- @sara_security: prepare subproc packet + accept-to-sign questionnaire

emma_sdr: Customer asked for final statement: "no inference or model artifacts leave EU for this POC" — can we put that in writing for the contract?

aj_prod_engineer: We can assert: for the Hosted EU geo-pin config with `failover: []` and BYO-KMS set, inference data and model artifacts remain in EU regions and are encrypted with customer-managed keys. Control plane metadata minimal, but we will route control plane to EU control-plane endpoints for this customer. I will draft the precise clause.

deploybot: :white_check_mark: POC routing feature flagged on internal tracker #POC-8734 (no deploys yet)

emma_sdr: Thanks all — looping in FinBank for signoff tomorrow.
